title: Tome widget (0.6.0)
description: Schema for the body of a :::widget directive (YAML or JSON, parsed to an object), merged with its directive attributes (type, id, ref, required). Course Format Spec 0.2.x, §7. Discriminated on `type`.

required.description: Must be completed to pass the next checkpoint. Defaults: true for graded widgets, false otherwise.

inlineMarkdown.description: Inline Markdown only: emphasis, code, math, links. No block elements or directives.

expression.description: Expression in the §7.5 expression language (numbers are also accepted). Syntax is checked by the validator.

text.description: Inline Markdown with blanks: {{answer|alt}} for text, {{=1.5}} or {{=1.5~0.01}} for numeric with tolerance. Must contain at least one blank.

diagram.$comment: Reserved but unimplemented in 1.0: always fails, so a course cannot ship a widget no player renders.

blockMarkdown.description: Block Markdown: paragraphs, lists, code blocks, tables, math. No directives.
